explanationAr: نستخدم الماضي التام (had + التصريف الثالث للفعل) لحدث وقع قبل حدث آخر في الماضي: When I arrived, the meeting had already started. أي أن الاجتماع بدأ أولًا، ثم وصلتُ. وإذا كان الترتيب واضحًا من before أو after، فيمكن أحيانًا استخدام الماضي البسيط: I left after I finished the report.
explanationEn: Use the past perfect (had + past participle) for an action that happened before another past action: When I arrived, the meeting had already started. The meeting started first, then I arrived. If before or after already makes the order clear, the past simple is often fine: I left after I finished the report.

comparison.ar: عندما وصلتُ، كان الاجتماع قد بدأ.
comparison.en: When I arrived, the meeting had already started.

examples.en: By the time the crew arrived, the rain had stopped.
examples.ar: عندما وصل الطاقم، كان المطر قد توقف.

examples.en: She had worked in two companies before she joined us.
examples.ar: كانت قد عملت في شركتين قبل أن تنضم إلينا.

examples.en: We realized that we had used the wrong drawing.
examples.ar: أدركنا أننا كنا قد استخدمنا المخطط الخطأ.

examples.en: Had you seen the site before the visit?
examples.ar: هل كنت قد رأيت الموقع قبل الزيارة؟

exercises.prompt: When we reached the station, the train ___.
exercises.explanationAr: غادر القطار أولًا، ثم وصلنا، فنستخدم had already left.

exercises.prompt: I ___ (not / see) the report before the meeting.
exercises.explanationAr: حدث قبل حدث آخر في الماضي: had not seen.

exercises.sentence: After he has finished the test, he wrote the report.
accepted: After he had finished the test, he wrote the report.
After he finished the test, he wrote the report.
exercises.explanationAr: القصة في الماضي، فلا نستخدم has finished. نستخدم had finished أو finished.

exercises.prompt: They told us that the pump ___ twice that week.
exercises.explanationAr: التعطل حدث قبل أن يخبرونا، فنستخدم had failed.
had set حدث أولًا، ثم before the rain started.

exercises.sentence: By the time I arrived, everyone has gone home.
accepted: By the time I arrived, everyone had gone home.
exercises.explanationAr: By the time + ماضٍ، فنستخدم had gone.

exercises.prompt: She was tired because she ___ all night.
exercises.explanationAr: العمل كان قبل التعب في الماضي: had worked.
